clue.text: Could men possibly like The Times’ pages?

indicators.note: possibly suggests one arrangement among many, so the preceding letters may be laid out differently

blocks.note: the two words supply the letters to rearrange

explanation.surface: A wondering aside on whether men could be suited to the newspaper's pages.
explanation.definitionFit: Newspaper pages are printed in vertical text strips, so they are laid out in columns.

clue.text: Transparent sheet for animation, one in suspect scale

indicators.note: in places the single letter inside the word for a suspect

blocks.note: a cel is a celluloid sheet used in hand-drawn animation
I is the Roman numeral for one
sus is British slang for suspect

explanation.surface: Animation cels and one dubious scale make an odd mix of art supplies.
explanation.walkthrough: Sus (from suspicious) is British slang, as in the old sus laws on stopping suspects.
explanation.definitionFit: The Celsius system measures temperature in degrees, with water freezing at zero.

clue.text: See porky in undergarment? Extremely far from ugly

indicators.note: in places the lie inside the item of clothing

blocks.note: lo is an old word for look, see
porky, short for pork pie, is rhyming slang for lie
a vest is a sleeveless undershirt

explanation.surface: Someone spots a plump figure in underwear and judges it not ugly at all.
explanation.walkthrough: Porky is British rhyming slang: pork pie means lie. A vest in Britain is an undershirt.
explanation.definitionFit: Being as far as possible from ugly means being the most beautiful, the superlative of lovely.

clue.text: Astonishing feat of vehicle moving up in race

indicators.note: in a down entry, moving up means reading from bottom to top
in places the turned vehicle inside the race

blocks.note: a car is a vehicle
the mile is a classic running race

explanation.surface: A driver makes an amazing climb through the field in a motor race.
explanation.definitionFit: A miracle is an extraordinary, seemingly impossible event or achievement.

clue.text: Cut up over politician on the French case

indicators.note: in a down entry, up means reading from bottom to top

blocks.note: to axe is to cut
MP, Member of Parliament
le is French for the

explanation.surface: A French court case involving a British politician is cut short.
explanation.walkthrough: Over and on simply stack the pieces in a down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: A case in point is a particular instance, illustrating something more general.

clue.text: Minister’s aide’s retreat about key company

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the retreat wraps around what follows

blocks.note: a den is a private retreat
A is a musical key
CO is the abbreviation for company

explanation.surface: A clergyman's assistant has a hideaway near an important firm.
explanation.walkthrough: The second ’s stands for is, joining definition to wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A deacon is an ordained church officer who assists the priest or minister in services and pastoral work.

clue.text: Criminal chap for a bit of bovver?

blocks.note: Des, short for Desmond, is a man's name
per means for each, a, as in per day
bovver is British slang for trouble or aggro, and ado is a bit of fuss

explanation.surface: A man turns outlaw just for a spot of hooliganism.
explanation.walkthrough: Bovver is British slang (from bother) for rowdy trouble-making.
explanation.definitionFit: A desperado is a reckless outlaw, typically a bandit of the American Wild West.

clue.text: Who may take characters (or letters) from Alberta via Toronto?

definitions.text: Who may take characters (or letters) from Alberta via Toronto?

indicators.note: taking characters from a phrase means lifting a run of its letters out unchanged

blocks.note: the run spans the end of the first word, all of the second and the start of the third

explanation.surface: A question about who carries mail between two Canadian places.
explanation.walkthrough: Letters plays both ways: the hidden letters, and post a pilot may fly across Canada.
explanation.definitionFit: A pilot flying a mail plane from province to city would carry correspondence across Canada.

clue.text: Supervise setting poetry in Old English

indicators.note: setting one thing in another means placing it inside, as a jewel is set

blocks.note: verse is poetry
OE is the abbreviation for Old English

explanation.surface: An editor oversees verse composed in Anglo-Saxon.
explanation.definitionFit: To oversee is to watch over and direct the work of others.

clue.text: Those used to sea voyages following one existing stomach remedy

indicators.note: following places the sailors after the first part, setting the order of the two pieces

blocks.note: one who lives, i.e. exists
old salts are experienced sailors

explanation.surface: Seasoned sailors reach for a cure for an upset belly.
explanation.walkthrough: Liver here is read as one who lives, not the organ.
explanation.definitionFit: Liver salts are a fizzy laxative powder taken dissolved in water to settle indigestion.

clue.text: Fish that is lacking tail

definitions.note: plural: several of one kind of freshwater fish

indicators.note: lacking a tail means the final letter of the phrase is dropped

blocks.note: id est is the Latin for that is

explanation.surface: A fish missing its tail.
explanation.walkthrough: Id est, abbreviated i.e., loses its last T.
explanation.definitionFit: The ide is a European freshwater carp-like species, and several of them are ides.

clue.text: Working police train son, having authority over him?

indicators.note: working suggests material being processed and reshaped, so the letters are reordered

blocks.note: the three words supply all fourteen letters

explanation.surface: An officer is coaching a boy, with power over him.
explanation.walkthrough: The Latin phrase means in the place of a parent, as a teacher or guardian acts towards a child.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting in a parent's stead, legally gives an adult responsibility and control over a child.

clue.text: Functions introducing eastern European school of painting’s style

indicators.note: introducing means bringing in, so the functions take the letter inside them

blocks.note: sines are trigonometric functions
E is short for eastern
E is short for European

explanation.surface: A mathematics lesson somehow drifts into Eastern European art.
explanation.definitionFit: The Siena school was an Italian movement of medieval and early Renaissance painters, known by this adjective.

clue.text: One nursed by tireless flying doctor?

indicators.note: nursed by means held close, so the single letter is cradled inside the next word
flying suggests letters scattered through the air, landing in a new order

blocks.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
taken as written, to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A patient is cared for by an indefatigable doctor who flies to rural areas.
explanation.walkthrough: Doctor looks like a noun for the nurse's colleague, but it is the verb for neutering a pet.
explanation.definitionFit: To doctor a cat or dog is to neuter it, making it unable to breed.

clue.text: Gets on “soundly” without women in general

indicators.note: soundly here means by sound, so the spoken word stands for one spelt differently

blocks.note: one fares well or badly, i.e. gets on
ex means without, as in ex dividend

explanation.surface: Someone manages well enough with no women around.
explanation.definitionFit: The fair sex is an old-fashioned collective phrase for females as a group.

clue.text: To him, sins destroyed religious belief

indicators.note: destroyed means broken up, so these letters are wrecked and rebuilt

blocks.note: the three words supply the letters

explanation.surface: For a believer, sin wrecked his faith.
explanation.definitionFit: Shintoism is the native Japanese faith, worshipping kami spirits of nature and ancestors.

clue.text: Issued blood without too much kept stored

indicators.note: without here means outside, so the bleeding goes around the excess

blocks.note: to bleed is to lose blood
OTT, over the top, means excessive

explanation.surface: A wound bled without losing too much.
explanation.walkthrough: Without reads as lacking in the surface, but here it means outside, its older sense.
explanation.definitionFit: Wine or preserves put away in glass containers are kept for later use.

clue.text: Where one sees retired skater run for captain?

blocks.note: a skater who has retired from the rink is off ice
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: A former skater stands for the role of team captain.
explanation.walkthrough: Retired skater suggests a sports star, but it is read as the skater's position: off the ice.
explanation.definitionFit: A captain is a commissioned rank in the army or navy, so a commissioned soldier or sailor.

clue.text: Fuss about station food in Mexico

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the fuss goes around the abbreviation

blocks.note: a to-do is a fuss
STA is the abbreviation for station

explanation.surface: Someone makes a scene about snacks at a Mexican railway station.
explanation.definitionFit: A tostado is a fried, crisp corn tortilla eaten in Mexican cooking, often topped.

clue.text: Stuffing cod, say, work with a bit of pasta like macaroni

indicators.note: stuffing means filling something, so the fish is filled with the other parts
a bit of means only a small portion, here the opening letter

blocks.note: cod is an example of a fish
OP is short for opus, a work
the first letter of pasta

explanation.surface: A kitchen instruction: stuff cod and serve with some pasta, macaroni style.
explanation.walkthrough: Macaroni looks like the pasta but is an 18th-century word for an overdressed dandy.
explanation.definitionFit: An eighteenth-century macaroni was a vain dandy who affected continental fashions, so dandified.

clue.text: Pelt round after one so wildly

indicators.note: after places the ring-shaped letter later than the single letter

blocks.note: a pelt is an animal's fur
I is the Roman numeral for one
O is round in shape
taken as written

explanation.surface: A frantic dash, pelting round after someone.
explanation.walkthrough: Pelt looks like a verb meaning race, and round like an adverb; both are nouns here.
explanation.definitionFit: Furioso is an Italian musical direction telling the performer to play with furious energy.

clue.text: Cautiously introduce power — owns home without energy

indicators.note: without means outside, so the earlier words go around the last one

blocks.note: P is the symbol for power
to own is to have
in means at home
E is the symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A householder brings in electricity gradually, having a home with no power.
explanation.definitionFit: To phase something in is to bring it into use gradually, stage by stage.

clue.text: Make rough speed north round outskirts of Slough

indicators.note: round means surrounding, so the rushing word encloses the edge letters
outskirts are the edges, so only the first and last letters are kept

blocks.note: to hare is to run fast
N is short for north
the first and last letters of Slough

explanation.surface: A driver races north on the ring road around Slough and roughens up.
explanation.walkthrough: Slough is a commuter town west of London.
explanation.definitionFit: Harshen is a verb meaning to make harsher, coarser or more severe.

clue.text: Is Israel concerned with splitting element for source of power?

indicators.note: splitting means dividing in two, so the element is broken open around the other parts

blocks.note: taken as written
Sion, or Zion, is a name for Israel
re means about, concerning
an element or contributing part is a factor

explanation.surface: A question about whether Israel is involved in nuclear work.
explanation.walkthrough: Element tempts towards a chemical symbol, but it is a factor.
explanation.definitionFit: A nuclear plant splitting atoms generates heat that drives turbines to make electricity.

clue.text: Official record showing a court answer

blocks.note: taken as written
CT is the abbreviation for court
A is short for answer

explanation.surface: A transcript records a reply given in court.
explanation.definitionFit: Acta is the Latin plural for proceedings or transactions, used for minutes of meetings.

clue.text: Make poor group of African warriors keep quiet about past

indicators.note: the warriors keep the hush beside them, so the two parts sit together
about means surrounding, so the joined parts go around the final word

blocks.note: an impi is a Zulu regiment
sh is a call for quiet
something over is finished, past

explanation.surface: A band of warriors is told to stay silent about their history.
explanation.definitionFit: To reduce someone to poverty is to drain them of money and resources.

clue.text: Poet mostly reserved about source of rhymes

indicators.note: mostly means not quite all, so the last letter is dropped
about means surrounding, so the shortened word goes around the next part
the source of something is its beginning, so the first letter is taken

blocks.note: a table reserved is booked
the first letter of rhymes

explanation.surface: A rather shy poet circles around where his rhymes come from.
explanation.walkthrough: Rupert Brooke was the English poet of The Soldier, killed in the First World War.
explanation.definitionFit: Rupert Brooke wrote sonnets including The Soldier, so he is a famous English writer of verse.

clue.text: Boyfriend is guy Manon treated roughly

indicators.note: treated roughly means handled carelessly and knocked out of shape, so the letters are jumbled

blocks.note: the two words supply the letters

explanation.surface: Her boyfriend is the man who mistreated Manon.
explanation.walkthrough: Manon is the heroine of operas by Massenet and Puccini.
explanation.definitionFit: A young woman's beau or partner is often called her young man, an old-fashioned phrase.
